title: General issues and unresolved faults
summary: Reviews in this topic center on owners reporting multiple general issues, with some saying problems are absent or minor but many describing unresolved faults, software or system misbehavior, and purchase frustration.

positive.summary: Positive reviews say the car has had no issues or no issue compared with a previous model, supporting willingness to recommend it.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe multiple or recurring issues, including unresolved faults, software problems, key-related trouble, unpredictability, and an inability to recommend the car.

mixed.summary: Mixed reviews acknowledge issues such as system misbehavior but frame them as minor or balanced by otherwise good ownership impressions.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention stress or a navigation voice-use problem, but the excerpts are too incomplete to assign a clearer sentiment from the supplied examples.

limitations: The sampled fragments are dominated by brief generic mentions of 'issues', so the exact underlying components or failure modes are often unspecified.
Several excerpts are too short or incomplete to determine the precise problem context or full sentiment.
This topic may mix unrelated problems such as software, key, navigation, and general quality concerns rather than one single coherent issue cluster.
